description: Hochsauerlandkreis Windkraftanlagen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
